Arcane Trickster: A rogue who blends spellcasting with stealth. You gain the ability to cast certain wizard spells.
Archery: Fighting Style: +2 bonus to attack rolls when using a ranged weapon.
Assassin: You master the art of killing. You gain advantage on attack rolls against creatures that haven't acted yet.
Battle Master: You study the art of combat, learning tactical maneuvers to use in battle.
Beast Master: You form a bond with a beast companion to aid you in combat.
Careful Spell: Metamagic: When casting a spell that forces other creatures to save, you can protect some from full effect.
Champion: You follow the martial tradition of the Champion, focusing on critical hits and raw might.
Circle of the Land: You draw on the power of nature to cast spells. Your circle provides additional spells based on terrain.
Circle of the Moon: You can transform into more powerful beasts. Your Circle forms a deep bond with the moon.
College of Lore: You specialize in knowledge and versatility. You gain cutting words and additional magical secrets.
College of Valor: You inspire bravery and combat prowess. You gain martial weapon proficiency and combat inspiration.
Defense: Fighting Style: +2 bonus to AC while wearing armor.
Distant Spell: Metamagic: Increase a spell's range by half when casting.
Draconic Bloodline: Your innate magic comes from draconic heritage. Your bloodline grants you scales and a powerful presence.
Dueling: Fighting Style: +2 bonus to damage when wielding a single melee weapon one-handed.
Eldritch Knight: You combine martial prowess with magical study. You bond with a weapon and learn defensive spells.
Empowered Spell: Metamagic: When you roll damage for a spell, you can reroll a number of those dice equal to your Charisma modifier.
Extended Spell: Metamagic: Double a spell's duration when casting.
Great Weapon Fighting: Fighting Style: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die, you can reroll it and take the higher.
Heightened Spell: Metamagic: When casting a spell that forces a save, you can give one target disadvantage.
Hunter: You specialize in hunting dangerous prey. You gain features like Colossus Slayer, Giant Killer, or Horde Breaker.
Knowledge Domain: Gods of knowledge. You gain guidance spells and can become an expert in two skills.
Life Domain: Gods of healing and preservation. You gain powerful healing and can lay on hands to others more effectively.
Light Domain: Gods of light and truth. You gain light-based spells and can blind attackers.
Nature Domain: Gods of nature. You gain charm person-like abilities and can talk to animals.
Oath of Devotion: Sacred Oath: You pledge to serve light and good. You gain authority and protection effects.
Oath of Vengeance: Sacred Oath: You seek to destroy evil wherever it lurks. You gain powerful pursuit abilities.
Oath of the Ancients: Sacred Oath: You protect the ancient ways. You gain nature-themed abilities and resistance to charm.
Pact of the Blade: You can conjure a melee weapon through your patron. You can also use it to summon armaments.
Pact of the Chain: You gain a magical sprite familiar. Others can also see through your familiar's senses.
Pact of the Tome: You gain a book of shadows with cantrips. You can also use it as a ritual book.
Path of the Berserker: When you rage, you go into a frenzy that makes you stronger but harder to control.
Path of the Totem Warrior: You follow the totem spirit. Your rage gains additional effects based on your totem animal.
Protection: Fighting Style: When a creature attacks someone within 5 feet, you can use your reaction to give them disadvantage.
Quickened Spell: Metamagic: You can cast a spell as a bonus action instead of an action.
School of Abjuration: You specialize in protective magic and warding. You create arcane wards to protect yourself and others.
School of Conjuration: You specialize in creating and summoning. You can use minor conjuration to summon small objects.
School of Divination: You see the future. You gain powerful divination spells and can improve your predictions.
School of Enchantment: You master charms and commands. Your enchantments can affect multiple targets.
School of Evocation: You blast your enemies. Your evocation spells deal additional damage.
School of Illusion: You create powerful illusions. Your illusions become more convincing and harder to see through.
School of Necromancy: You master death and undeath. You can harm the living and heal the undead.
School of Transmutation: You change the nature of matter. Your transmutations provide various useful effects.
Subtle Spell: Metamagic: You can cast a spell without somatic components or visible signs.
Tempest Domain: Gods of storms and sea. You gain lightning/ thunder abilities and can use your armor as a weapon.
The Archfey: Your patron is a fey being from the Twilight Court. Your magic has beguiling and misty qualities.
The Fiend: Your patron is a fiend from the lower planes. Your magic draws on infernal power.
The Great Old One: Your patron is a mysterious entity from beyond. Your magic whispers of alien horrors.
Thief: You excel at infiltration. You can Use Magic Devices and take the Hide action as a bonus action.
Trickery Domain: Gods of trickery and knowledge. You gain proficiency with disguise and can create illusions of others.
Twinned Spell: Metamagic: You can target a second creature with a spell that normally targets only one.
Two-Weapon Fighting: Fighting Style: When dual-wielding, you add your ability modifier to damage of the off-hand attack.
War Domain: Gods of war. You gain martial prowess and can make attacks as bonus actions.
Way of Shadow: Your discipline focuses on stealth and surprise. You can hide and move silently.
Way of the Four Elements: You learn to manipulate ki into elemental effects like fire bolt or water walking.
Way of the Open Hand: Your discipline focuses on defeating opponents through precise strikes and manipulation.
Wild Magic: Your innate magic comes from unpredictable wild magic. Your sorcery surges unpredictably.
